Good morning, Jacques,

Thank you for your message.

Please note that the above rate is applicable only for June and July. If you require the apartment from August onwards, the rental rate will be different.

At this time, we are only able to confirm rates for up to 3 months. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide rates for 6 or 8 months in advance due to current market conditions and fluctuations.

Please let us know your preferred dates, and we will be happy to assist you further.
